name: Trilogy Kuki Youka Shinden
original_name: トリロジー 九鬼妖華真伝
source:
The fight of the Kuki and Yasha clans continues from the Meiji Restoration. Yasha clan member is weaving threads around the heroine Kuki Kyoha.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从明治维新时期开始的九鬼一族与夜叉一族之争延续至今。一名夜叉族人正悄然在女主角九鬼京华周围织下罗网。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
